messages:
Sloane: Quick sync  assembling KeplerSys QBR deck. Need owners for: health slide, renewal-risk paragraph, action tracker, and one tight exec ask. Can we assign now?

Arjun: Ill own onboarding status + rollout metrics. will add a short note on pilot blockers.

Becky: Ill draft the renewal-risk paragraph and mitigation owners. will call out SSO, retention clarity, and region quotas.

Vik: Ill build the action-items slide and enablement gaps. prefer keeping detailed timeline in the runbook link.

Lena: Ill drop a short customer quote and the usage sparkline into the openslide.

Sloane: runbook -> https://redwood.app/s/ks-qbr-runbook (appendix slide #11). Final deck Mon 9am PT, dry run Mon 2pm PT, exec Tue 11am PT. If slides missing by 9am I will reassign.

qa-bot: QBR template v2 deployed at 2141600200 -> /decks/templates/qbr-2025-v2.

Arjun: onboarding note: 5 pilots, 2 blocked on infra quotas. Proposed exec ask: "Authorize emergency quota allocation to unblock KeplerSys pilots (target: 48-72h)." adding to slide.

Becky: draft risk paragraph:
"KeplerSys health: 66/100. Principal risks: 1) SSO integration lag delaying user adoption; 2) unclear retention terms creating legal friction; 3) capacity quotas preventing pilot scale. With focused exec support on quota approvals and short-term SSO engineering, renewal probability improves materially."

Vik: action items (deck summary):
- Becky: mitigation paragraph + owner matrix (Mon EOD)
- Arjun: onboarding slide + exact quota error (Mon 8:30am)
- Vik: action tracker + appendix pointer (Mon 8:45am)
- Lena: quote + visuals (pushed)
- Sloane: update CRM stage & coordinate dry run (Mon)

Arjun: infra error (for appendix):
```
error: region quota exceeded: requested 16 vCPUs in eu-west-2, available 0
stack: infra/provisioner/alloc.go:142
```
Will confirm exact wording with infra.

Lena: shortened customer line for main slide: "Integrations worked well; paused on region enablement." full quote in appendix.

Becky: mitigation ask for exec slide (single line): "Approve quota allocation + 3 weeks of prioritized SSO engineering to remove sign-on blocker."

Sloane: CRM note  I will flip SFDC to "At Risk - Exec Assist" once Becky posts the final mitigation language. Also will ping Sales Ops to prepare the quota justification doc.

Arjun: can someone from Sales Ops add ARR impact bullets for the quota request? helps the exec ask.

Vik: adding ARR impact and owner-level cost in the action tracker appendix.

Becky: posting final mitigation copy here for quick review: "Mitigations: 1) Prioritize SSO engineering (owner: Product Eng) — ask: ~3 weeks dedicated bandwidth; 2) Publish retention SLA and confirm with Legal (owner: CS/Product); 3) Expedite region quota approvals with Sales Ops/Infra (owner: Infra). Exec ask: approval to allocate quota and short-term eng resources to resolve SSO."

Arjun: small wording tweak: change "~3 weeks" -> "~2-3 weeks" for flexibility.

Becky: updated.

Sloane: timeline reminder: Mon 9am final deck -> Mon 2pm dry run -> Tue 11am exec. If anyone misses the 9am cut I will cover their slide. Tagging: @Arjun @Becky @Vik @Lena. :raised_hands:

Lena: :thumbsup:

Arjun: will have slide in by 8:45am for review.

Vik: linking action tracker now. appendix slide #12.

(4 reactions on Sloane's last message: :white_check_mark: :rocket: :eyes: :thumbsup:)
